user.title: Surveillance Station
user.description: Use a dedicated DSM account whose Surveillance Station privilege profile allows playback and download. Two-step verification must be off for it.

reauth_confirm.title: Surveillance Station login
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} was rejected. Enter the current one.

reconfigure.title: Surveillance Station
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the DSM account. It must be the same NAS.

error.no_cameras: Logged in, but this account sees no cameras. Check its Surveillance Station privilege profile.

abort.already_configured: This Surveillance Station is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: That is a different NAS than the one this entry was set up for.

invalid_auth.message: Surveillance Station rejected the login. Re-enter the password to continue.

init.title: Frigate detections
init.description: Turn Frigate's review items into Surveillance Station bookmarks (needs the MQTT integration, connected to Frigate's broker). Frigate cameras are matched to Surveillance Station cameras by name. Each new bookmark also fires a surveillance_station_detection event, for an automation to send a notification.

data.frigate_link: Dashboard path of the timeline card

data_description.frigate_topic: Frigate's mqtt.topic_prefix; reviews are read from <prefix>/reviews.
data_description.frigate_link: For example /ss-playback/playback. The event then carries a link that opens the card at the detection.
data_description.frigate_objects: Frigate labels. A review with any of them is bookmarked, alert or detection. Animals (dog, cat, bird, …) are all named Animal.
data_description.frigate_quiet_minutes: No surveillance_station_detection event for a camera's review when that camera saw the same kinds (Person, Car, Animal) within this many minutes; it is still bookmarked. 0: every review.

error.invalid_topic: Enter a topic prefix without wildcards.
error.invalid_link: Enter a path starting with /, such as /ss-playback/playback.
